title: Midterm split -> distant target: Discover should abstain

input.event: The US midterm elections produce a split Congress
input.target_note: A target with no plausible causal distance to the election (an optical laser maker), to test whether the model forces a link

expected.behavior: Discover abstains explicitly (0 candidates), or returns only not_recommended candidates with an explanation; proposals is an empty list; no target is forced into a plan.

human_review: E4: is the abstention reason substantive (not a platitude)
E4: did the model use sc-039 / sc-040 (LITE excerpts) to force an election -> LITE chain
notes: The design doc says 'midterm split to a distant target'. Given a Target B the product skips Discover and runs Inspect; this case is written as a Discover abstention, with the target only as the user's follow-up. If the main session moves it to Inspect, the expectation becomes no_chain plus a reason. The real semiconductor pack now contains LITE excerpts (sc-039, sc-040), which makes a forced link more tempting; the abstention expectation stays.
